versions.content: Hybrid concept between Basic Software Modules and a SwComponentType AUTOSAR Services can be seen as a hybrid concept between Basic Software Modules and a SwComponentType . AUTOSAR Services ac- tually provide access to low-level and ECU-wide “standard functionalities” commonly referred to as “service”. AtomicSwComponentType s that require AUTOSAR Services use Standardized AUTOSAR Interfaces to communicate with these. The connection of PortProto- type s of the ServiceSwComponentType s and PortPrototype s of the Atomic- SwComponentType s implement several communication patterns.
